text: For the past 10 years, the City of Toronto and many downtown neighbourhoods have been inundated with an increasing number of development projects. While development is crucial to meet the expected population growth of our vibrant City, it is important that any new construction contributes to the health and well-being of our communities and neighbourhoods. The western section of the Garden District has seen a sudden rise in construction-related projects that have added new stress for area residents. Presently, there are eight developments underway within this catchment that have active construction sites.
